items.title: Einspruch against income tax assessment 2025
items.quote: Für den Einspruch haben Sie einen Monat Zeit; die Frist läuft ab dem Ende des Tages, an dem der Bescheid als bekannt gegeben gilt.
items.computation: Letter is dated (and, absent a separate 'zur Post gegeben' date, treated as posted) Tue 02.02.2027. As a Finanzamt notice, delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (§122 Abs. 2 Nr.1 AO): 02.02.2027 + 4 days = Sat 06.02.2027. Since the 4th day is a Saturday, for tax offices the deemed-delivery day itself moves to the next working day (§108 Abs. 3 AO, BFH IX R 68/98): Mon 08.02.2027. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) runs from the end of that day (§187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.2 BGB) and ends one month later on the day with the same number: 08.03.2027. 08.03.2027 is a Monday (not a weekend/holiday), so no further shift under §108 Abs.3 AO/§193 BGB is needed.
